summary: Forward Industries filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $25M registered direct offering of 3,125,000 common shares at $8.00 per share to one institutional investor, versus a $8.60 close on September 22, 2026, implying a roughly 7% discount. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners serves as exclusive placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis, earning a 5% cash fee of $1.25M, leaving about $23.75M before expenses. Settlement is expected on or about September 24, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch FWDI's post-deal trading liquidity and any follow-on pricing pressure from the discounted placement shares.
